label: 1g-producer-t1
ticket: T1 prefetch the per-row predecessor in expand
verdict: REJECTED: prefetching text[p-1] eight rows ahead changes nothing (expand_pipe 15.90 -> 16.03 s, order 45.80 -> 45.58 s, both within noise).
finding: The producer's OWN expansion is 15.9 s for 1,000,000,666 rows - 16 ns per row. In the end-to-end 1 GB arm expand_pipe is 380.8 s, so 96% of that phase is the producer waiting for its consumers. At 10 GB the measured 4,551 s therefore contains about 160 s of work and ~4,400 s of stall.
consequences: T3 (heavy-class fan-in) is worthless: there is no expansion CPU to save.

Every remaining second of the emission wall is consumer side: m20 feed and the v10 writer, both single-threaded. I1 (K independent range pipelines) and I3 (m20 over context runs) are the only levers left.
